zh: 覆盖升级后旧窗口自动换新；修复通话稳定性：接通检测更快、对方挂断不再拆桥、减少开头噪声；修正新版本检查频率；日志降噪。
en: Old windows now refresh automatically after an in-place upgrade; call stability fixes include faster answer detection, keeping the bridge running after remote hangup, and reduced opening noise; corrected update-check frequency and reduced log noise.
